verbetes.glosa_atual: poço; fonte de água; por extensão, origem ou sepultura.
definicoes_originais: remember בְּאֵירְךָ וכ' thy well (whence thou camest), thy pit (grave), thy Creator; Lev. R. s. 18, beg.— Pl. בְּאֵרוֹת.
notas_originais: Gen. R. s. 93; a. fr.—Erub. X, 14 (104 ab), v. הָקֵר. Taan. 9 a ב' בזכות מרים the well in the desert was given to the Israelites for Miriam’s sake; a. fr.—Transf. origin. Y. Sot. II, 18 a (play on בוראיך, Koh. XII,
Y. Erub. II, beg. 20 a ב' הקר, v. הָקֵר. V. בּוֹר II.
Targ. Cant. I, 1; v. בֵּירָא

definicoes_originais: (dial. for בַּרְקָא, v. ברק a. deriv.; cmp. בָּאגָא a. בִּקְעָא) sparkling, effervescent; white-shining.
notas_originais: Ab. Zar. 30 a מתוק חמר ב' Ar. (ed. מי ב') by ‘sweet wine’ we understand effervescent wine (liquid) ( mulsum vinum or mulsa aqua, v. Sm. Ant. s. v. Vinum).—Snh. 98 a סוסיא ב' quot. in Rashi to Ab. Zar. l. c., Ar. s. v. ברקא (ed. ברקא) a white-shining horse. [Deriv. fr. Pers. bârah is refuted by ברקא being used as an equivalent of our w.; v. also Fl. to Levy Talm. Dict. I, 284 a.]
ident. with בֵּירַי in Galilee. Pesik. R. s. 28; Midr. Till. to Ps. CXXXVII; Yalk. a. l.
בֵּי ב' in Babylon, v. בֵּירַאי

verbetes.glosa_atual: tornar-se mau; apodrecer; cheirar mal; insultar.
definicoes_originais: , v. בּוֹא) to be disordered, bad (cmp. רַע).
to cause decay, to make smell badly.
(with דברים, or sub. דברים) to use insulting language.
(v. בְּאוּשָׁה) [ to begin to ferment, to boil,] to be in the early stage of ripening, to be b’ushah.
notas_originais: . Ex. R. s. 26; a. e.
. Koh. R. to X, 1.

Ter. X, 2 אע"פ שה' מימיו מותרין Ms. M. (ed. מימיו מימיו corr. acc.) though the barley has begun to ferment &c. Cant. R. to I, 2 b המים מַבְאִישִׁים liquids grow stale. Pesik. B’shall. p. 81 b דג מב' ill-smelling fish.
Maasr. I, 2 grapes are subject to the law of tithes משהִבְ' from the time they would be called b’ushah, cmp. Y. ib. 48 d. Shebi. IV, 8. Tosef. Maasr. I, 1.
, v. בָּתַר

definicoes_originais: (reduplic. of בא, v. בּוֹא; cmp. b. h. בִּאָה a. מָבוֹא) entrance, door, gate.
notas_originais: Targ. Esth. V, 14.—Sabb. 32 a, v. חוּטְרָא a. בִּזְיוּנָא I. Ib. 156 b קרי אכ' called at the door (begging). Erub. 11 b; a. fr.— Pl. בָּבֵי. Ber. 58 b; a. fr. Men. 34 a בָּאבֵי.—Trnsf. (of writings) section, clause. ב' דרישא the clause of the first proposition. Sabb. 3 a top; a. fr.—Hence ב' קמא (abbr. ב"ק), (ב"מ) ב' מציעא, (ב"ב) ב' בתרא Baba Kamma, Baba Metsia, Baba Bathra (first, middle, last section), names of three Talmudic treatises of the order of N’zikin (civil law); v. נֶזֶק. [Tosefta Kelim is likewise divided into three Babas with the same names.].— Pl. as above. R. Hash. 33 b תקיעה דכולי ב' the tune T’kiah in all the three sections.

verbetes.glosa_atual: Bab Nahara; canal ou afluente do Eufrates.
definicoes_originais: Bab Nahăra (Gate of the River) name of a tributary or a canal of the Euphrates.
notas_originais: Ab. Zar. 39 a דב' נ' (Ms. M. דנהרא); Succ. 18 a (Ms. M. 1 דבנהרא, 2 דפום נהרא, cmp. Yeb. 16 b sq.).
, v. בָּב I a. בָּבִיתָא.

verbetes.glosa_atual: Baba ben Buta; discípulo de Shammai.
definicoes_originais: Baba (ben Buta), a disciple of Shammai, blinded by Herod.
notas_originais: B. Bath. 3 b. Kerith. VI, 3. (Cmp. Jos. Ant. XV, 7, 10.)

verbetes.glosa_atual: pupila do olho; menina dos olhos.
notas_originais: f. (b. h.), only in בָּבַת עין the pupil of the eye. Ex. R. s. 30 ב' ע' העליונה (some ed. בת; corr. acc.) the Lord’s &c. V. בָּבִיתָא I

definicoes_originais: hatred (only in Targ. Y., = דְּבָבוּ; ד rejected through false analogy, v. דְּבָבָא).
notas_originais: Targ. Y. Gen. XXV, 11; a. e.

definicoes_originais: (in Babli), בּוּבְיָא, בּוּבְיָה (in Y.) f. (onomatop., v. Fl. to Levy Chald. Dict. I, 419 a. Fried. Del. Assyr. Stud. I, 142; v., however, בָּבִיתָא) reflected image in metal, water &c.; image, shadow.
notas_originais: Ned. 9 b ונסתכלתי בבב' שלי (Ar. with two ב, corr. acc.) and I was looking at my image (in the water); Tosef. Naz. IV, 7 (Var. בוביא); Y. Ned. I, 36 d bot. בובייה; Num. R. s. 10 בוביא. Yeb. 122 a ב' דב' a shadow of a shadow. Ab. Zar. 47 a לב' קא סגיד he worships the image (in the water). Gen. R. s. 4 ב' גדולה magnified image. Treat. Sof’rim. III, 8 ב' שלו the outlines of an effaced letter.

definicoes_originais: (v. preced.) prop. mirror, hence (from its shape) a musical instrument, a little drum, tympanum (used at orgies, v. Sm. Ant. s. v. Tympanum).
notas_originais: Y. Taan. I, 64 b bot.
, v. בֵּיבַי

definicoes_originais: (cmp. בָּב a. בַּיִת) = h. בָּבָה, [ the innermost,] with עֵינָא, pupil of the eye.
notas_originais: Targ. O. Deut. XXXII, 10 בָּבַת ע' (plur.) the pupils of their (the Israelites’) eyes; [Targ. Y. בבא דעיוניה Ar. (ed. בָּבֵי) the innermost or the gates of His thought, v. בָּב I]. Targ. Prov. VII, 2 בבתא (Ms. בבייתא). Targ. Koh. XII, 2 בבי עינך (some ed. בני, גבי, corr. acc.). Gitt. 69 a בביתא.
Ḥull. 85 b על ב' דמיא Ar. (ed. בו') over the outlet (wherein the flax is put); v. יָנִיבָא.

definicoes_originais: (fr. בָּבָא or fr. בית) gate (or lodging) money, contribution for the support of traveling poor.
notas_originais: Y. Dem. III, beg. 23 b

verbetes.glosa_atual: Babel; Babilônia; cidade e região mesopotâmica.
definicoes_originais: (b. h.) pr. n. Babel, the city of Babylon; Babylonia, a country of varying limits, chiefly comprising Mesopotamia, a portion of Great Armenia and some neighbouring countries east of the Tigris (v. Neub. Géogr. p. 320).
notas_originais: [Owing to the continued political disturbances in Palestine, Babylonia gradually became the centre of Jewish scholarship; hence both the frequent comparisons and jealousies between the East and the West (Babyl. a. Palest.); cmp. אֶרֶץ, חֲנַנְיָה, תַּלְמוּד. Kidd. 69 b; 71 b. Sot. 49 b. Y. Snh. I, 19 a; Y. Ned. VI, 40 a bot. כי מב' תצא וכ' (sarcastic imitation of Is. II, 3). Snh. 24 a תלמודה של ב' Babylonian method (Talmud). עולי ב' those coming from Bab. to visit the Temple, pilgrims. Ned. V, 4 דבר של ע' ב' that in which pilgrims from Bab. (i.e. Jews living abroad) have a share, as the Temple Mount &c. [Macc. 24 a, a. e. המונה של ב', read רומי as Ms. M.; cmp. אֲרָמִי.]

Targ. Josh. VII, 21 (some ed. בַּבְלִי).—Sabb. 105 b ב' O, thou Babylonian! B. Mets. 85 a גמרא ב' (Ms. M. תלמודיה דבבל) the method he had learned in Babylonia; cmp. preced.—Y. Sabb. VI, 8 a bot.; a. fr.— Pl. בַּבְלָאֵי. Targ. Ps. CXXXVII, 3. Ḥull. 45 a חברין ב' our Babyl. colleagues. Keth. 75 a, a. fr. ב' טפשאי foolish Babylonians.—Fem. בַּבְלִיתָא. Targ. l. c. v. 8.— Pl. בַּבְלָיָתָא, בַּבְלָיָיתָא. Targ. II Esth. I, 10.—Sabb. 81 a
Cant. R. to I, 6 (a legend about the origin of Rome) and they called it רומי ב' Rome-Babylon.

Pes. 66 a הילל הב' Hillel the Babylonian; a. fr.— Pl. בַּבְלִיִּים, בַּבְלִיִּין. Yoma 66 b; Men. 100 a. Cant. R. to VIII, 9; Lam. R. to I, 13 ספסלין מלאין ב' וכ' students’ seats in Palestine occupied by Babylonians; [for מונחי Lam. R. l. c. prob. to be read מומחין].
, v. בַּבְלָאָה
Yalk. Josh. 18 פורפירא ב'; (Gen. R. s. 85 בבליא).
, v. בַּבְלָאָה
, v. בָּעוּ
, v. בָּבִיתָא I
, v. בָּאוָת
B. Kam. 27 b; a. fr. Kidd. 10 b Joh. son of B. B.
, v. בָּאגָא

verbetes.glosa_atual: agir com violência; rebelar-se; ser infiel.
definicoes_originais: v. infra) to act violently, to rebel, be faithless.
notas_originais: Snh. 37 a (allud. to Gen. XXVII, 27) א"ת בְּגָדָיו אלא בּוֹגְדָיו do not read b’gadav (his garments), but bog’dav (his faithless ones). Y. Peah I, 16 b top; Num. R. s. 10, beg.; Cant. R. to V, 16, v. בְּגִידָה.—Mekh. Mishp., N’zikin 3 מאחר שב' בה וכ' (b’bigdo bah, Ex. XXI, 8) since he &c., treated her contemptuously (opp. to the interpretation of בגדו as his garment, שפירש בגדו עליה he spread his bed-cloth over her). [From Targ. renderings as well as from Agadic interpretations it appears that the primitive meaning of בגד (√בג) is, to tear; also to despise, corresp. to the meanings of √בז; v. Targ. Job VI, 5; Is. XXXIII, 1; Prov. XXI, 18; Snh. 94 a, cit. s. v. בזוזא; Esth. R. to I, 10, cit. s. v. בּוּז; Mekh. l. c.; cmp. also K’thib בג for K’ri בַּז Ezek. XXV, 7.—בֶּגֶד seems to be a piece, web, corresp. in meaning and use to φᾶρος.]

Men. 40 b היא של ב' וכ' if (the garment) itself is a web, but its borders are of leather. Ib. the principal element ב' בעינן must be a web (in order to require Tsitsith). Mekh. Mishp., N’zikin 3, v. preced. Sabb. 26 b; a. fr.— Pl. בְּגָדִים, constr. בִּגְדֵי. Gen. R. s. 20 ב' א"הר Adam’s garments, v. אוֹר II, 3. Yoma 60 b ב' לבן the Highpriest’s white garments (for the Day of Atone, Lev. XVI, 4), contrad. to ב' זהב gold-embroidered &c. Ib. 68 b; a. fr.
, v. אֲוָנָא II

verbetes.glosa_atual: corrigir para מִגְדַּל יוֹן, localidade perto de Sídon.
definicoes_originais: , Gen. R. s. 98 ב' דין, read מִגְדַּל יוֹן pr. n. pl. Migdal Yon, near Sidon; v. Neub. Géogr. p. 295.

verbetes.glosa_atual: Bagdat; localidade natal de Rabi Hanna.
definicoes_originais: Bagdath (prob. Eski Bagdad, Neub. Géogr. p. 360), birth place of R. Ḥanna.
notas_originais: [Kidd. 71 b, v. אֲוָנָא II.]—Hence:
Yeb. 67 a; a. e.—Succ. 52 b Ms. M. (ed. באגדתא, corr. acc.).

definicoes_originais: , read בַּרְגִּימִינִין or בַּרְגִּימִינָא m. pl. (farcimen,—ina) stuffings of sausage, sausages.
notas_originais: Y. Sabb. VII, 10 a bot. כד מקטע ב' when cutting the sausages through (dividing them off), v. באנטרין. Y. Bets. IV, 62 c bot. the sausage-maker is forbidden to work on a Holy Day משום מקטע ב' because he cuts the sausage-bags apart; v. סיקורא.

— Pl. בְּגִידוֹת. Y. Peah I, 16 b top (play on bigdothekha, Ps. XLV, 9) כל בגידות שבגדת וכ' all sinful acts thou hast committed, shall (after repentance) be like myrrh &c.; Num. R. s. 10, beg.; Cant. R. to V, 16.
, v. גִּין
Targ. Y. Gen. XXVII, 11 quot. in Tosef. Yom Tob to Keth. III, 8, a. e. (ed. סערן).
, v. גְּלָאי

verbetes.glosa_atual: corrigir referência a vogal ou som vocálico.
definicoes_originais: , Ms. Oxf. בגלאטורי, Sabb. 103 b, a corrupt. of בּוֹגָלִיס לִיטִירָא (or בּוֹגָאלִיס) (vocalis litera) open sound, vowel.
notas_originais: כיון דאיתיה ב' וכ' since it has merely the value of a vowel letter, one is guilty for writing two Alephs on the Sabbath (v. R. S.’s opinion ib. מלאכה שכיוצא בה מתקיימת). [Differ. in commentaries.]
, v. פָּגַן

verbetes.glosa_atual: alcançar a maturidade feminina; tornar-se maior de idade.
definicoes_originais: (√בג, v. בָּאגָא; cmp. חֲזָזִית) [ to be rough (of surface, voice &c.);] to be wrinkled (of a female’s nipples), whence; to become of age (at twelve years and a half).
notas_originais: Keth. III, 8 הבּוֹגֶרֶת a girl of beginning maturity (v. Tosef. Yom Tob a. l.). Nidd. V, 7 כיון שבָּגְרָה as soon as she is mature, v. צֶמֶל. Pes. 113 a (prov.) בתך ב' וכ' has thy daughter become of age? Set thy slave free and give him to her (as husband); a. fr.—Tosef. Keth. III, 8 תִּיבָּגֵר (Nif.); Y. ib. 27 c bot. תִּבְגּוֹר.

verbetes.glosa_atual: ser maior de idade; tornar-se áspero ou rouco.
definicoes_originais: to produce a rough surface, to heat and bruise by friction.
notas_originais: . Targ. Y. Num. XXX, 11, sq.
B. Bath. 167 b בגר לה קלא her voice has become rough (from old age).—Denom. בַּגִּיר.
Nidd. 66 a שפופרת אַבְגּוּרֵי מבגר לה Ar. (Var. אנג' מנג', ed. אפג' מפג') will not a tube bruise her?—Keth. 65 a מבגר לה (the ropes of the bedstead) hurt her.

Y. Kidd. I, 59 b ימות הב' the period of majority. Y. B. Bath. IX, beg. 16 d. Kidd. 4 a ב' דאיילונית majority of a barren (or wombless) woman (who has no signs of maturity and becomes of age at twenty years). Keth. 38 b יש ב' בקבר can the legal consequences of becoming of age enter after the woman’s death? [Other form: בּוֹגֶר. Y. Keth. V, 29 d לאחר בּוֹגְרָהּ after her becoming of age.] V. בַּגְרוּת.

Tosef. Keth. V, 1 הב' כתביעה (read בת', Var. ed. Zuck. הבּוֹגֶרֶת בתביעה) she who is of age when asked (by her betrothed) to be married; Y. ib. 29 d הב' בשעה (corr. acc.). Ib. נותנין לב' וכ' a girl of age is allowed twelve months for preparation for her wedding.—Ch. v. בַּגִּיר.

definicoes_originais: , Lev. R. s. 28, end, קומוס ב', read קוֹמִיס פְּרִיבָטוֹן (κόμης πριουάτων) = comes privatarum, v. דומין.

notas_originais: , v. גּוּנְדְּרָא

verbetes.glosa_atual: maturidade feminina; condição após doze anos e meio.
definicoes_originais: (v. בֶּגֶר) womanhood, (after twelve years and a half), opp. to נערות, maidenhood (between twelve and twelve and a half) and ילדות childhood (from three to twelve years).
notas_originais: Y. Yeb. I, 3 a top אין בין … לימות הב' וכ' between the period of maidenhood and that of womanhood there is no more than a six months’ interval; Keth. 39 a; a. fr.

verbetes.glosa_atual: prefixo בִּדְּ־: a respeito de; quando; se.
definicoes_originais: prefix (comp. of בְּ a. דְּ = h. בְּשֶׁ־, בְּשֶׁל)
concerning that ( those) of; at the time of; treating of what refers to.
notas_originais: Sabb. 112 a בדטייעי in the case of those (sandals) of the travelling merchants (Arabs). Yoma 78 b, v. הוּצָא. Ḥull. 20 a ומתני' בדלא אהדר our Mishnah treats of a case when he did not turn. Gitt. 49 a בדניזק וכ' we go in our assessment by (the property) of the injured; a. v. fr.
Targ. Y. Gen. XLIII, 5 בִּדְּלֵית unless. Targ. O. Deut. IX, 4 בִּדְּיִתְּבַר; a. e.
= אֲבַד. Targ. Y. II, Num. XXI, 29 ובָדְתוּן (Var. וּבַדְתּוּן = וַאֲ'). Ithpe. אִתְבִּיד, v. אֲבַד

verbetes.glosa_atual: lagar de azeite; tanque de prensa.
notas_originais: Shebi. VIII, 6 אין … בַּבַּד you must not press olives in the tank (in the Sabbath year).—בית הַבַּד the building containing the tank and all implements for pressing olives. Sabb. I, 9 קורת ב' הב' the beam of the press; a. fr.—Bets. 19 a; Tosef. ib. II, 7, v. גַּב.— Pl. בַּדִּים, בַּדִּין. B. Bath. IV, 7 בית הב'. Toh. IX, 7 בד אחד או שני ב' a quantity of olives for one tank or for two; a. fr.

definicoes_originais: with pref. לְ, לְבַד (b. h.) alone, only.
notas_originais: Ber. 63 b (play on baddim, Jer. L, 36) שיושבין ב' ב' who study separately (without interchange of ideas). Kerith 5 a expl. Ex. XXX, 34 ב' בב'.

Sot. 8 a אותה לְבַדָּהּ her (Num. V, 19) indicates her alone (each separately); a. fr.—בִּלְבַד (adv.) only. Ber. I, 1 ולא זו ב' (usu. with אמרו) and not only in this case did they make such a rule. Meg. I, 5 אין בין … אלא … ב' there is no difference between Festivals and the Sabbath (as to forbidden labors) except only as to the preparation of the necessaries of life; a. fr.—וּבִלְבַד but only, provided. Zeb. V, 8; a. fr.

Zeb. 18 b ב' שיהו של בוץ וכ' wherever the Law speaks of garments of bad, it means that they must be of byssus, new &c. Ib. how do we know דהאי ב' כיתנא הוא that bad (as material for garments) means linen (and no other fine stuff)? Answ. Something which grows בד בבד in single stalks (v. preced. a. next w.); Yoma 71 b. Ib. 35 a bad is used four times, intimating מובחר בב' the choicest of &c. (for diff. vers. v. Rabb. D. S. a. l. note); [cmp. Targ. Jer. XLVIII, 30].

definicoes_originais: (בדד) single stalk, twig; also (b. h.) pole, bar.
notas_originais: Zeb. 18 b; Yoma 71 b; v. preced. Keth. 17 a ב' של הדס myrtle twig. Succ. 44 b even one leaf וב' אחד and (on) one twig. B. Mets. 24 a anything on which something is suspended ב' קרו ליה is called bad.— Pl. בַּדִּים. Y. Yoma V, 42 b bot., a. e. בין הב' between the bars projecting from the Ark (i.e. their corresponding place in the Second Temple). B. Mets. l. c. בַּדֵּי מחטין וכ' poles of peddlars for needles &c. Ib. מאי בדי what does baddé mean? Answ. Twigs.—And why do they call them baddé? Answ., v. supra. V. אַנְפּוֹרְיָא.
Targ. Joël II, 24 Ar. (ed. בֵּירַיָּא). Snh. 95 a תותי בי ב' under the wine press (Var. בי סדיא).

definicoes_originais: = h. בַּד IV, fine linen woof.
notas_originais: Y. Sabb. XIII, beg. 14 a
, v. בדי
m. ch. = h. בַּדַּאי. Ḥull. 63 a ההוא ביידא הוה (corr. acc.; Yalk. Zech. 578 בדאה) that man was a liar.
, v. בַּדָּיוּת

Snh. 89 b (prov.) כך עונשו של ב' וכ' such is the punishment of the liar &c.; Ab. d’R. Nath. ch. XXX; Gen. R. s. 94 מה טיבו של ב' הזה; v. טִיב. Kidd. 49 a he who translates a Bible verse literally (v. צורה), הרי זה ב' is a liar (misrepresenting the sense).

Deut. R. s. 5, a. fr. דברים של ב' fictitious words (mitigating the original report); ib. דברי ב'.— Pl. בַּדָּאִים, בַּדָּאִין. Y. Gitt. IV, 46 a bot. נמצאו הדברים ב' things turned out to be false. B. Bath. 74 a; Snh. 110 ab Moses and his laws are true והן ב' and they (euphem. for we) are liars. Tosef. Keth. II, 1 ב' אנו (ed. Zuck. מבודין) we have been telling a falsehood.
, v. בָּאדָן

verbetes.glosa_atual: espalhar; dispersar; cavar; criar; ficar solitário.
definicoes_originais: to dig out, create, choose, invent.
notas_originais: Y. Yoma V, 42 c top בּוֹדְדָהּ ברגלו he scatters it (the frank-incense) with his foot (shoves it apart).
Denom. בַּד II, בַּדִּים.

Part. בּוֹדֵד lonely. Pesik. R. s. 29 (30), expl. בדד (Lam. I, 1) = בּוֹדֵד lonely, forsaken. Part. pass. בָּדוּד exiled. Lam. R. to I, 1 בגדים בדודים Ar. (read בגדי) garments of the exiled (כלי גולה, Jer. XLVI, 19); [ed. בגדי בָדָד, a. בְּדָדִין, v. next w.].
. Lam. R. introd. (R. Alexandri
(ref. to Ps. CII, 8) as the bird מִתְבּוֹדֵד וכ' is driven (separated from the rest) from roof to roof.

definicoes_originais: preced.) loneliness, (adv.) in a lonely state, in exile.
notas_originais: Snh. 104 a יהיה ב' מושבם the exile shall be their dwelling. Lam. R. to I, 1 בגדי ב' garments (outfit) of exile, v. preced.— Pl. בְּדָדִים, בְּדָדִין. Ib. בגדי ב' (plur. abstr. as חיים &c.).

definicoes_originais: (denom. of בַּד II) olive-treader, workingman in the olive press.
notas_originais: Gitt. 62 a.— Pl. בַּדָּדִין. Toh. X, 1 sq. Sabb. 19 b שמן של ב' וכ' the oil (remnants in corners) belonging to the pressers, and the mats which they use. B. Kam. 119 a והב' לוקחין מהן וכ' (read מנשותיהן, v. Rabb. D. S. a. l. note 40) you may buy from the oil pressers’ (Rashi: oil producers’) wives &c. Tosef. Maasr. I, 10 הב' (ה)מדליקין וכ' the oil pressers who take their lighting oil (alternately) from one press and another.
, v. בְּדִידָה
Tosef. Kel. B. Mets. X, end (ed. Zuck. גרדין, v. גַּרְדּוֹן).
, v. בדי
, v. בְּדִי II
, v. next w.

verbetes.glosa_atual: de costas; com as costas voltadas.
definicoes_originais: (Arab. dubr, back) with one’s back to.
notas_originais: —Ber. 6 b (speech of an Arab) ב' קיימת וכ' Ar. (Ms. M. בדו בר, ed. כדו בר, corr. acc.) with thy back (to the Synagogue) standest thou before the Lord?
, v. כַּדּוֹרִית
— Pl. בָּדוֹחֵי. Taan. 22 a אינשי ב' וכ' we are merry-makers and cheer up the sad.
Targ. Ps. CL, 5 דמשמעין לבדוחא Ms. (ed. incorr. דשמעין בלחודיהון) which are sounded for rejoicing. Ib. LXVIII, 32 בבודחא Ms. (ed. בנוי דחם).
, v. בדי

verbetes.glosa_atual: bdélio; goma resinosa ou pedra preciosa.
definicoes_originais: (b. h.) b’dola ḥ, name of a jewel, also of a gum, bdellium.
notas_originais: Gen. R. s. 16, beg. את סבור כב' וכ' you might think, b’dolaḥ (Gen. II, 12) means the druggists’ bdellium—let its neighbor (next word אבן השוהם) explain it (correct. acc. to Yalk. Gen. 21).
Targ. Gen. II, 12; a. e.
, read בְּרוּקְלֵי.
— Pl. בְּדוּקַיָּא בְּדוֹ'. Targ. Y. Num. V, 19; a. e.

verbetes.glosa_atual: pessoa cuja paternidade deve ser examinada.
definicoes_originais: (בדק) one requiring examination, i.e. one whose father is unknown, usually שְׁתוּקִי.
notas_originais: Kidd. IV, 2 Abba Saul called the sh’thuki ב' b’duki. Y. ib. II, 65 d bot.; Bab. ib. 74 a
Targ. Is. VIII, 22 (ed. Vien. בַּדּוּר), a. e.
Targ. II Sam. XIV, 13 sq.
, v. פַּרְוִילָא
B. Bath. 145 a, a. fr. הא דר' … ב' היא R. …’s account (or opinion) is a mistake. [Ar. reads בָּרוּתָא q. v.]

definicoes_originais: (denom. of √דח, v. דְּחַהּ; cmp. בִּזְרָא) to be cheerful.
notas_originais: Targ. Y. Ex. XVIII, 9; a. fr.—Ber. 30 b, a. fr. ב' טובא was very cheerful. M. Kat. 17 a בְּדִיחָא דעתאי I feel happy. Sabb. 77 b.—*Ḥull. 32 a לא הוה בדיחנא ביה וכ' I could not make light of my uncle so as to ask him (Ar. ed. pr. בדיקנא).
Taan 22 a, v. בָּדוֹחָא. Ned. 51 a have I not cautioned thee דלא תבדחן not to make us laugh? Ib. 50 b bot. תבדיחן (En Yaak. תבדחן).

definicoes_originais: , v. בדד) to dig out, whence
(cmp. ברא) to take out (a piece of dough) and shape, to form.
to be tempted to a falsehood, turn a liar.
notas_originais: Men. V, 1; Sifra Emor Par. 10, ch. XIII השאור בּוֹדֶה וכ' he gets the leaven required for the loaves out of themselves (taking a piece of dough out of that intended for the loaves).

Ned. 10 a לשון שבָּדוּ וכ' terms (for vows) which the Scholars have (arbitrarily) invented (as disguises). Lev. R. s. 9 לשון בָּדוּי an invented expression. Gen. R. s. 100 דברים בְּדוּיִים fictitious words. Ib. s. 48 בדויים (sub. דברים, some ed. בדאות).

Y. Meg. I, 71 c top בי' להן וכ' made up for them a false Latin translation (of the Bible) from the Greek; v. בָּרַר.—Y. Keth. II, 26 b bot. מְבַדִּין היינו we have been inventing, i.e. speaking in fun; Tosef. ib. II, 1 מבודין אנו (corr. acc.; Var. בדאים). [Y. Kidd. III, 64 d מבדין אתם וכ', prob. to be read מן הדין.] [Y. Shebi. IV, 35 b bot. מבדין בחדשים, v. בָּהָה.]
Tanḥ. Balak, 14; ed. Bub. 23 (ref. to baddim, Is. XLIV, 25) מְבַדִּין וכ' they frustrate their predictions.
Ber. 4 a; Der. Er. Zut. ch. III train thy tongue to say, I do not know, שמא תִּתְבַּדֶּה וכ' lest thou be induced to tell a falsehood and be caught.

definicoes_originais: to be declared wrong, to be mistaken.
notas_originais: Targ. Y. II. Num. XVI, 28 בְּדֵית (Var. בָּדִית).
Y. Yeb. VIII, 9 c עברת בִּידָּךְ תלתא נהרין ואִיתְבַּדַּת thy story crossed three rivers (coming from Babylonia) and is found to be a mistake; Y. Sabb. II, 9 a top ואיתבר' (corr. acc.).

definicoes_originais: , Pa. בַּדֵּי, בַּדֵּה (dialect. = בזי) to despise.
notas_originais: Cant. R. to VIII, 1 (ref. to לא יבזו לי ibid.; read:) לית דו מבדה לי there is none can despise me (for kissing my brother); [Ex. R. s. 5 beg. corrupt].
, Yalk. Deut. 913 ב' פלסטין, v. דִּיפְּלֵי
Bekh. 8 b מילי דב' ed. (Ar. כדי, En Yaak. כדיבי) some stories.

Kel. XXIX, 7 יד הב' the handle of a spade.— Pl. בְּדִידִין. Y’lamd. Sh’laḥ quot. in Ar. ב' בברזל(?).—2) rut, cavity (cmp. next w.).— Pl. as above. M. Kat. 4 b; Tosef. ib. I, 2; ib. Shebi. I, 7 ב' שבעיקרי וכ' the cuts around the roots of trees; v. אוּגְיָה.

definicoes_originais: (בדד, v. בַּד II) small olive press.
notas_originais: Sifra B’har ch. I one may grind the olives in the large tank ומכניס לבד' and then put them into the small press; Shebi. VIII, 6 לבוד'.— Pl. בְּדִידוֹת. Gen. R. s. 31 Ar. (ed. בדדיות, בדריות, corr. acc.).
Lev. R. s. 9. Gen. R. s. 48, v. בָּדָא.
, v. בְּדַח
Constr. בְּדִיחַת. Targ. Esth. VIII, 17.
Sabb. 30 b מלתא דב' something humorous. Ber. 55 a בדיחותֵיה מפכחא ליה its very cheerfulness frustrates it (the good dream).

verbetes.glosa_atual: tribunal; repartição pública; tesouraria do governo.
definicoes_originais: (contr. of בי דייני) prop. court-house, in gen. government’s building, public building, treasury.
notas_originais: Ber. 56 a ב' דמלכא וכ' ed. (Mss. בֵּי זְיוּנָא, בִּזְיוּנָא q. v.) the king’s treasury shall be broken into. [Perl. Et. St. p. 25 refers to Pers. divân which, however, seems of too late an origin for the Talmudic date, v. Cycl. Brit. 9 th ed. s. v. Divan.]

verbetes.glosa_atual: por causa de; em benefício de; para que.
definicoes_originais: (comp. of בְּ, דִּי, a. לְ = h. בְּשֶׁל) as to what refers to—whence; on account of, for the sake of, in order that.
notas_originais: Targ. O. Gen. VI, 3; a. e.—Lev. R. s. 28, end אזל ב' בלנאי he went for (the sake of getting) a bather. Y. Kidd. III, 64 a ב' דלא יכפור וכ' in order that he may not deny his owing a cup. Yoma 75 b ב' רבא וכ' (v. Rabb. D. S. a. l.) through the merit of the teacher is the scholar supported.—בְּדִילִי, בְּדִילָךְ &c. on my, thy account &c. Targ. O. Deut. III, 26; a. e. (Y. בגלל; b. h. למען).
Tanḥ. Mishp. 17 לשון ב' an expression meaning ‘creating a partition’.
